We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Let's parse: It's a para-methyl phenyl sulfonamide attached to another phenyl ring bearing an α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl attached to phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-aniline.

We need 3 steps retrosynthesis: likely disconnections:

1. Amide formation: disconnect amide between carbonyl and aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So precursor: α,β-unsaturated carboxylic acid (or acid chloride) attached to phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2) and aniline as nucleophile. So step: coupling of carboxylic acid (or activated) with aniline to give amide.

2. Formation of α,β-unsaturated acid via Doebner modification: from aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid to give the unsaturated acid attached to phenyl. So precursor: aromatic aldehyde (para-sulfonyl phenyl aldehyde) and malonic acid.

3. Sulfonamide formation: attach sulfonyl chloride to p-toluidine (or p-tolyl amine). So precursor: p-toluidine (para-methyl aniline) and sulfonyl chloride derived from sulfonyl group attached to phenyl ring (the other phenyl). Actually sulfonyl chloride is derived from sulfonylating agent: p-tolyl-sulfonyl chloride? Wait target sulfonamide: NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(... )cc2 attached to p-tolyl ring. So sulfonyl chloride would be ClSO2-c2ccc(... )cc2 (aryl sulfonyl chloride). So we need that aryl sulfonyl chloride as precursor, reacting with p-toluidine to give sulfonamide.

Thus three steps:

Step1 (retro): amide bond cleavage -> gives α,β-unsaturated acid (c2ccc(/C=C/COOH)cc2) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). Actually the amide is C(=O)N attached to aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So product: aniline (para-aminophenyl?) Wait the aniline is unsubstituted phenyl with an NH2 at para? The SMILES: Nc3ccccc3N indicates an aniline with two amines? Actually "Nc3ccccc3N" is an aniline with an amine attached to phenyl and also an NH at the start? Let's parse: N c3 c c c c c3 N. That's an aniline where the nitrogen is attached to the carbonyl (as amide) and also the phenyl has an NH at the other end? Actually the SMILES: ...C(=O)N c3ccccc3 N . So carbonyl attached to N which is attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3) which has an N substituent at the other end (the terminal N). So it's a phenyl with an amino group (aniline) attached to the amide nitrogen (i.e., anilide with an extra NH2 para? Not sure). But we can treat as aniline (para-aminophenyl) as nucleophile.

Thus step1: amide formation from α,β-unsaturated acid and 4-aminophenylamine (p-phenylenediamine). Actually the phenyl has an NH at the other end (maybe ortho?). But we can just propose aniline (c1ccccc1N) as precursor.

Step2: Doebner modification: from aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) where the aldehyde is para to sulfonyl group? The aldehyde is attached to the phenyl that also bears sulfonamide. So the aldehyde is on that phenyl ring. So precursor: p-tolyl-sulfonyl phenyl aldehyde (i.e., 4-(methyl) phenyl sulfonyl attached to phenyl with aldehyde). So we need that aldehyde.

Step3: Sulfonamide formation: from p-toluidine (para-methyl aniline) and aryl sulfonyl chloride (the sulfonyl chloride derived from phenyl-sulfonyl chloride). The aryl sulfonyl chloride is the same phenyl that later becomes aldehyde after step2? Actually the sulfonyl chloride is attached to phenyl ring that later becomes aldehyde. So we need aryl sulfonyl chloride (ClSO2-Ph-CHO). So step3: sulfonyl chloride + p-toluidine -> sulfonamide.

Thus we have three steps.

Now we need to produce JSON route with nodes: root molecule, children reaction nodes, each with template_id. We need template IDs. We can search for templates for amide formation, Doebner modification, sulfonamide formation.

Search for amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine). Use functional_groups_broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid, functional_groups_formed: amide. Already attempted but got empty. Maybe need to specify "amide" as formed, but earlier got empty. Could be that template exists but not returned due to limited? Let's search without broken/formed criteria just molecule_smiles of product (the amide). Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with only molecule_smiles? It required at least one criteria list. Could use functional_groups_formed: ["amide"] only.
